in_scope: Finding spare parts by part number or description
Identifying equipment associated with spare parts
Checking inventory quantities and minimum stock levels
Comparing supplier lead times and minimum orders
Determining delivery times and offer validity
Checking weather forecasts at delivery ports
out_of_scope: Quoting prices or terms not in the documents

audience.who: chief engineer of a cargo fleet

must_answer.example_question: What is the part number for the fuel pump?
Which equipment does part number 12345 belong to?
How many spare parts are on board for the ballast pump?
What is the lead time for parts from Bluewake Supply?
Can you estimate the total cost for ordering 5 units of part number 67890?
How many days will it take for the delivery to arrive at the main port?
What is the weather forecast for the delivery port next week?
